ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is the primary coil of an ideal transformer connected to an AC power supply, with a fuse connected in series on the primary side; the two ends of the secondary coil on the right side are connected to the bathroom electrical circuit. Reasoning: The input voltage of the primary coil is u=311sin100πt(V), and its effective value is U1=311/√2=220V. The turns ratio of the primary and secondary coils of the ideal transformer is 5∶1, so the effective voltage of the secondary coil is U2=220×1/5=44V. All electrical appliances are working normally, and the rated power of the lighting lamp is 44W, so the current of the lighting lamp is I灯=P灯/U2=44/44=1A. The ammeter reading is 2A, and it measures the total current in the main circuit on the secondary side, so the current of the exhaust fan motor is I机=2A-1A=1A. The input power of the exhaust fan motor is P入=U2I机=44×1=44W. The internal resistance of the motor is 1Ω, and the coil heat loss is P热=I机²r=1²×1=1W. Therefore the output power of the exhaust fan is P出=P入-P热=44-1=43W.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：变压器副线圈两端接了并联的照明灯支路和排气扇电动机支路，电压表并在副线圈两端，电流表串在副边干路上，因此电流表示数是灯和电动机的总电流。再由文字给出的原线圈电压 u=311sin100πt(V) 求原边有效值为220V，理想变压器匝数比5:1，所以副边有效电压为44V。灯正常工作且额定功率44W，故灯电流 I灯=P/U=1A。干路电流为2A，所以电动机电流为1A。电动机输入功率为 UI=44W，内阻损耗为 I²r=1W，因此排气扇输出功率为44-1=43W。
